evidence.note: nn.Linear on LayerNorm'd input emits phases with std ~0.577 rad, so exp(i*phase) ~ 1 + i*phase and every wave collapses onto the all-ones vector. C2 (tiny phases) CONFIRMED. C1 (token indistinctness) REJECTED: token waves are distinguishable at 0.79066.

k4_repair.mechanism: phase_gain multiplies the phase map before exp(i*theta), spreading positions around the circle so the position ramp can act.
